name: – Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela – § 27, introductory part – Am 118
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 27. Rejects blanket increases above the draft budget for NDICI – Global Europe, the Reform and Growth Facility for Moldova and civil society organisations; insists that any expenditure under Heading 6 be limited to clearly defined interests of the Member States and be subject to measurable results, full transparency, anti-fraud controls and enforceable suspension clauses; calls for non-humanitarian assistance to third countries to be made conditional on effective cooperation on readmission, returns and the prevention of illegal migration; calls for humanitarian assistance to be concentrated primarily close to regions of origin and to remain strictly needs-based; rejects the use of NDICI – Global Europe, humanitarian aid or any other Heading 6 budget line to supplement or circumvent the appropriations and conditionality applicable to the Ukraine Facility or the Ukraine Support Loan;
